correctness.rationale: Twist commutation is exactly \(P\beta=\beta P\). The even and mixed Nijenhuis equations are automatic after this commutation because left multiplication by \(\varepsilon\) is \(\beta/2\). The odd bracket is the standard alternating form, so the final equation is exactly \(\det(P-\lambda I)=0\). Automorphisms are determinant-one odd maps commuting with \(\beta\). Exact finite-field enumeration confirms the counts, ranks, and conjugacy normal forms.

value.rationale: The source family is the paper's first concrete finite-dimensional Hom-Lie antialgebra, so its operator geometry is a natural benchmark. The Nijenhuis variety jumps from dimension \(2\) to \(4\) at \(\mu=\pm1\), while the resonant quotient collapses to \(q(q+2)\) classes. The deformation formulas explain why the extra resonant matrix directions are partly invisible, adding structural content beyond counting.
